option_relations.rationale: Antiplakin dermatosis is another name for Anti-Envoplakin and Anti-Periplakin Pemphigus, which is the provided leaf.
Bullous pemphigoid is a distinct autoimmune blistering disease not directly related to anti-envoplakin and anti-periplakin pemphigus.
Paraneoplastic pemphigus is a distinct autoimmune blistering disease associated with underlying malignancy, and is not directly related to anti-envoplakin and anti-periplakin pemphigus.
Pemphigus vulgaris is a distinct autoimmune blistering disease not directly related to anti-envoplakin and anti-periplakin pemphigus.
